policy.final_held_out_outcome_access: After capture, recording-integrity checks may inspect topics, duration, timestamps, and corruption only. Do not inspect TIM outcomes or change thresholds until all final held-out bags, annotations, participant codes, clothing codes, and hashes are frozen.
policy.threshold_change_after_final_access: Create a new split version and treat the accessed final set as development data. It may not support the final held-out claim.
policy.legacy_validation_use: Diagnostic comparison only. Do not tune on it and do not call it held-out.
policy.algorithm_change_after_freeze: Before held-out outcome access, any deliberate behavior-affecting TIM, tracker, Target-ReID, model, or threshold change requires an explicitly versioned new prospective freeze. After held-out outcome access, a change made in response to those outcomes contaminates the accessed recordings; they cannot remain final held-out evidence.
policy.allowed_pre_outcome_inspection: Allowed before release: source recording integrity, topic presence, duration, timestamps, corruption, image quality sufficient for annotation, physical-person annotation, participant/outfit coding, and provenance. Forbidden before release: TIM correctness, candidate scores, comparative architecture outcomes, threshold diagnostics, or any result used to choose an algorithm/model/configuration.
policy.annotation_or_data_defect: A source or annotation defect may be corrected only independently of algorithm outcomes, with the correction documented, re-versioned where needed, and all affected hashes regenerated before final evaluation.
policy.implementation_defect_after_final_access: Stop evaluation and document the defect. Do not quietly patch and rerun. Determine explicitly whether the accessed held-out recordings have influenced the fix. If they have, those recordings are contaminated and must leave the final held-out set before any new final claim.
policy.final_evaluation_use: Final held-out data may compare only systems, thresholds, tracker settings, models, and evaluation rules frozen before held-out outcome access.

freeze.freeze_reason: TIM-MARS development continued after the July split freeze, including behavior-affecting target-fragment and hard-negative lifecycle changes. H01-H03 were never captured or inspected, so this v2 freeze prospectively binds the actual final algorithm before held-out outcome access.
